reviews.text: Excellent professionals! I recommend them.

Hello, I'm writing to say the following: last year, in March 2025, I left my dog ​​Jhow here. When we came back for vacation, we picked him up and he had a scraped nose. I didn't complain at the time, but this year, having already sorted everything out, the time came today when I went to take Jhow back because we're going on a trip. However, the staff refused to keep him simply because he started growling at them. This is a sign that he was mistreated last year.

Serious lack of care, negligence, and institutional dishonesty.

I am only publishing this warning now because I waited a year for an official response from the Order of Veterinary Doctors, which shifted operational responsibility to the commercial establishment. In August 2025, I left my healthy beagle at this hotel simply because of its proximity. At the time of collection (the 29th), the animal was returned to me with a serious injury to its paw, bleeding and unable to walk. The confrontation was immediate right there at the counter. Instead of acknowledging the accident, they refused responsibility, tried to charge for tests, and told me to take the dog home and "watch over her overnight." I returned the following morning (the 30th) to find my dog's health had worsened. Faced with another refusal of assistance and the absence of the Clinical Director on vacation, I had to urgently resort to Nina's usual veterinarian to treat a severe infection. To absolve the institution of blame, management later gave false statements to the Order, maliciously inventing that no one noticed anything during the delivery and that I refused immediate help. CCTV footage from the counter and the receipt from the 30th disprove this farce. Let this serve as a public warning: lack of care for a defenseless animal and a complete absence of integrity and character in managing the error. Think twice before entrusting your animals to this place.

Our 12-year-old Pug has been coming to your clinic for two years. This year, during a routine check-up, Dr. Inês detected two subcutaneous tumors, which she recommended surgical removal. The surgery was two months ago, and I can say that the process was very well managed, both pre- and post-operatively, with utmost care and professionalism. Thank you to the team and, especially, to Dr. Inês!
My Tsuky really likes the professionals there. Thank you for taking such good care of my girl.

Excellent veterinary clinic. We have been clients for quite some time and the experience has always been impeccable. The entire team demonstrates professionalism, competence, and enormous dedication to the animals, conveying confidence in all consultations and treatments.

Special mention goes to the clinic's boarding facility, which is an excellent solution when we need to leave our animals. The facilities are very good, the animals are treated with care and attention, and they always return calm and well cared for.

It's rare to find such consistent service over the years. I recommend this clinic without reservation to anyone looking for trustworthy professionals and high-quality care for their animals.
My cat was injured, and it was the nearest veterinary clinic I passed. She was bleeding, but they still wouldn't see us because they said they already had an appointment.
It has always been my cats' clinic. I recommend it.

The medical staff is very attentive and caring, as is the rest of the staff.
Consultations with Dr. Gil are excellent. He explains all the procedures to be performed.
Friendly people, but above all, empathetic and humane. Congratulations to all and much success! 😻😻😻

It was the first time I left my dog ​​at a dog hotel. I was apprehensive, I had never left her before.
It was a very positive experience, where I noticed a lot of care for my dog. She didn't eat her kibble for the first few days and was promptly given wet food until she started eating normally again.
They kept me updated on how my dog ​​was doing, which reassured me throughout her stay!
In addition, when I picked her up, I noticed the affection with which my dog ​​was treated and how comfortable and happy she was with the employee Regina, and that counts for a lot!!
To anyone who, like me, might be worried about making the right decision regarding where to leave their pet, I recommend this hotel. I feel that my dog ​​was well treated and welcomed, and in addition to the facilities being comfortable for the animals, the space has isolated enclosed parks that allow dogs to have individual space to play and run.

Highly competent professionals.
Special mention to Dr. Virginia.
I recommend them.

Impeccable, pleasant service, very careful. My Finoa had surgery and lacked nothing. Top top.
Best wishes to all.

Yesterday, December 3rd, 2025, I took my dog ​​to this clinic and was seen by a veterinarian who only examined my dog's ears, prescribed medication, and didn't even demonstrate how to administer it.

That night I tried to administer the treatment, and my dog, being in great pain, tried to bite me.

Today, December 4th, I called the clinic twice. The first time they said the veterinarian would call me back immediately; the second time was the same, and I'm still waiting for the call.

Unfortunately, it wasn't the best experience, as the consultation and medication weren't cheap, and I expected better service and aftercare than I received.

I highly recommend the dog hotel; the facilities are very good. Our dog, Juca, stayed there for ten days, and everything went very well. The professionals were excellent, from the transportation provided by Mr. António to the staff of the clinic and hotel, Gisela, Ana, and Rita, who were super friendly.

Fantastic experience.
Excellent professionals.
The doctor dedicated to Nina's care was super attentive.
The process is still ongoing, but so far, we are very pleased with everything we've experienced.
Thank you, team!

Whenever I needed urgent help, I was assisted.
First we called, and when we arrived at the clinic, the doctors were already waiting for us at the door.
Unparalleled professionalism, care, and respect for our four-legged babies.
My little gentleman was always very well cared for.
Thank you for the excellent service always.

I recommend this dog hotel for leaving your furry friend for a few days. The kennel is spacious, with two areas, one enclosed and the other open but sheltered. There's also a small playground. My dog ​​was calm and enjoyed his stay there the times he was there. The employee, Sandra, is very friendly and very concerned about the animals.
Clinic with a good reception area and a high-quality medical team.

Although it was advertised as being open 24 hours, it wasn't open and they didn't answer the phone until around 8 pm.
My dog ​​died when I finally arrived at another veterinary clinic.
I have a traumatised dog that desperately needed a cut. They handled it so well and so professionally.

Run away from this clinic if you want to see your animals needing help in times of distress! This clinic claims to be open 24 hours, but it's all a lie! I took my very sick cat to the door of this clinic, and it was closed, everything locked. The gate says to call a number, I called the number and nothing, it always disconnects when I call! Aren't you ashamed of what you do to people and animals? You should have been shut down already for the atrocities you commit against people. Someone is distressed with their animal needing help, and you say you're open 24 hours just to deceive them? Stop, look at the wickedness of what you do, and for the good of everyone and out of respect for animals and people, close down, because you are a SHAME!!!

After a long time investigating what was wrong with my cat's skin and hearing several nonsensical diagnoses from other veterinarians, I finally discovered that his recurring alopecia was due to a food allergy to grains. This was the only clinic that paid attention to the problem; the others immediately prescribed antidepressants because they said it was an anxiety problem. After starting the diet almost 5 months ago, his fur is almost completely bald.

The vets are super attentive. They offer emergency care on weekends at a reasonable price.
I went with my cat for the first time and received excellent service, with professionalism and kindness from Dr. Madalena.

Amazing, I cannot recommend them more! They helped me with everything from passports for my dogs, to vaccines, to assisting in the unfortunate passing of one of my dogs. All of the staff I interacted with on each visit were caring and knowledgeable. They went above and beyond for my unusual needs. Thank you!
A dedicated team, caring and attentive service, and happy animals make this clinic/hotel a top choice. I highly recommend it.
Assistants, attentive and well-prepared.
I really liked it, good facilities, helpful professionals, very friendly, I'll be a regular customer.

I received very poor service over the phone from a woman who refused a home visit despite the website advertising 24-hour availability.

Terrible treatment and very rude, with the sole purpose of convincing me to take my pet to the clinic.

We took our 2-month-old kitten to the clinic because he hadn't eaten for a day. He was diagnosed with a viral infection and prescribed an anti-inflammatory, without any tests or analyses being done to better investigate the symptoms. …
